title: Raw Fig Bars
description: Raw dried fig bars are not often found and these are topped with dark chocolate drizzle and a pinch of salt which make them hard to resist. —Sylvie Taylor @ Roamingtaste

requirementList.name: dried figs, ends removed and sliced into quarters

response.speechText: Place the quartered figs into a bowl and place in a double boiler, cover and add two tablespoons boiling water until the figs are warmed through, approximately 5 minutes.

paragraphs: Place the quartered figs into a bowl and place in a double boiler, cover and add two tablespoons boiling water until the figs are warmed through, approximately 5 minutes.
requirements: dried figs, ends removed and sliced into quarters

response.speechText: Meanwhile, place the nuts and seeds into a blender and pulse until roughly chopped. Set aside.

paragraphs: Meanwhile, place the nuts and seeds into a blender and pulse until roughly chopped. Set aside.

extraInformation.text: Much like a baseball game, a blender includes a base and a pitcher. (And sometimes, a batter!)

response.speechText: Place the warmed figs in a food processor and pulse on and off until roughly chopped and sticky (your food processor may become rather warm and you will have to clear out the blades every 30 seconds to a minute of pulsing, so give it time to cool down if necessary).

paragraphs: Place the warmed figs in a food processor and pulse on and off until roughly chopped and sticky (your food processor may become rather warm and you will have to clear out the blades every 30 seconds to a minute of pulsing, so give it time to cool down if necessary).
requirements: dried figs, ends removed and sliced into quarters

response.speechText: Place the figs in the bowl with nuts and seeds and stir until well combined.

paragraphs: Place the figs in the bowl with nuts and seeds and stir until well combined.
requirements: dried figs, ends removed and sliced into quarters

extraInformation.text: If you take a bowl and put it upside down, it becomes a poml.

response.speechText: Line a loaf dish with greasproof paper and spoon the mixture in, pressing down evenly on all sides. Refrigerate for a minimum of an hour.

paragraphs: Line a loaf dish with greasproof paper and spoon the mixture in, pressing down evenly on all sides. Refrigerate for a minimum of an hour.

response.speechText: Melt the chocolate and coconut oil, stirring until smooth.

paragraphs: Melt the chocolate and coconut oil, stirring until smooth.

extraInformation.text: Did you know that it took over eight years to develop the recipe for milk chocolate? Be glad you weren't one of those testers.
Chocolate is a one of the most popular forms of apology.

response.speechText: Remove the chilled bars from the fridge, slice and drizzle the chocolate over the top.

paragraphs: Remove the chilled bars from the fridge, slice and drizzle the chocolate over the top.

response.speechText: Sprinkle the pinch of course sea salt over the top.

paragraphs: Sprinkle the pinch of course sea salt over the top.

extraInformation.text: Careful with this one. Add too much salt, and it's going to taste all salty.

author: Sylvie Taylor @ Roamingtaste
